description: Triage a free-text strategic-risk question: route it to the relevant regional and sector modules and report which evidence categories a defensible answer would require. Required tool arguments: text. Follow inputSchema; this tool does not require a prior evidence packet unless the schema asks for one. Illustrative example arguments (synthetic; replace with your own data): {"text":"What evidence is needed before entering the Kazakhstan market?"}. This product offers 2 free trial attempts for strategic_risk_triage: call MCP free_trial_status, then MCP free_trial with that tool's own inputSchema arguments; no HTTP adapter or wallet is needed. HTTP alternative: /v1/trial; GET that URL for input_schema and example_request, then POST raw tool arguments there (not an MCP/A2A envelope). HTTP, MCP and native A2A share the allowance and daily capacity is limited. Other tools are not included in this trial. Evaluation on paid endpoints requires Base USDC payment or Pro access. Standard x402 v2, when enabled, signs a one-transfer authorization and durably binds its first admitted request. Legacy payment uses a funding-wallet signature over the exact request. Discovery is free. Keep the original request and X-Payment-Signature for result recovery within 24 hours. Current prices: https://agendamcp.dpdns.org/.well-known/x402. Do not pay automatically. Evidence triage only: no factual-truth verification, no legal, compliance, sanctions, or financial advice. Human review is required before any commercial action.
